translations.en: It was just an ordinary old @3rCoin@0r,
so I brought it back to give to @7rTanya@0r.
Well, I'm counting on you... Hic.
If the thief headed into @6rDiemen Labyrinth@0r,
they must be reasonably skilled.
You are curious about this @3rCoin@0r, too.
It seems you must catch the thief, whatever it takes.
Whaaat? Why, why, why?!
You won't do this one thing for me?
I'm really in trouble here!
Please, help me out and say yes!
All I can do now is cry!
Waaaaaaaaah!
I'm going to end up on the streeeets!
@7rFiore@0r collapses onto the table and starts crying.
You cannot tell whether the tears are real,
but her predicament certainly seems to be.
Hey, hey, hey! Listen to this!
I'm in such a mess!
I was enjoying a nice drink until a moment ago,
and when I looked, someone had stolen my precious @3rBag@0r!
Isn't it embarrassing for a thief to get robbed?
When you point this out, @7rFiore@0r turns bright red
and starts getting angry.
That's why I'm swallowing my pride and asking you!
I remember the face of the thief I think took it.
So go and catch them for me!
I could go after them myself, of course.
But, well, I've had a nice few drinks,
so running around isn't really my thing right now... Hic.
On the table where @7rFiore@0r was sitting,
there are about three empty bottles.
She certainly seems to have had a nice few drinks.
Heeey, pleeease?
Do me a favor and go look for it!
I'm not even asking you to catch the thief. Just get my bag back.
That's all! I won't ask for anything else!
Of course I'll pay you!
Come on, please! You won't bring down
divine punishment just for doing me this favor!
It is starting to feel as though a drunk has latched onto you.
Now, what should you do about this request?
While @7rAnselm@0r is drinking at the tavern,
@7rFiore@0r asks him to appraise the junk you brought back.
First, this rusty set of weapons and unfinished armor...
In a word... rubbish.
R-rubbish...
You mean they're only worth their weight in scrap iron?
More or less. The painted flounder plate is worth next to nothing, too.
It doesn't appear to have any value as an antique.
B-but I carried all that weight... all the way back here...
As for these glass fragments... these are...
R-rubbish?
They can't be restored, but they can be used as magical ingredients.
They'll fetch a decent price.
Even though they're rubbish?
They aren't rubbish. Grind them to powder, and they become ingredients.
Now, as for this filth...
It's an extremely rare kind of pickled squid.
In fact, this will probably sell for the most.
Th-this stuff is... food?
I don't care what it is! It's worth money, right?
Well, it should fetch a fair price.
At least your trip wasn't wasted.
Yay! So we did make a profit after all!
Anyway, here's your reward. Take it!
From @7rFiore@0r, you received a reward of @3r60,000 G@0r.
Come on, let's go! Treasure hunting!
Treasures you've never seen before are waiting for us!
Changed your mind? Want to go treasure hunting? You do, right?
You came to talk to me because you want to go, right? Right?
Still undecided? Deep down, you're yearning for adventure, aren't you?
Then let's go treasure hunting!
I knew it! You're the best!
Treasure hunting is so romantic!
Apparently, there are five spots on the upper levels of @6rWatering Labyrinth@0r.
Upper levels ought to mean the first and second floors, right?
Our clues are five words: Inktvis, Garnalen,
translations.note: Inktvis and Garnalen are Dutch fish-name location clues. Source phonetics differ from standard Dutch; spelling follows the glossary.

translations.en: Zalm, Tong, and Schol.
translations.note: Zalm, Tong, and Schol are Dutch fish-name location clues. Display spellings follow the glossary.

translations.en: They're probably place names.

context: Drunken Fiore pleads for the bag, then seeks treasure; Anselm appraises retrieved items and identifies valuable pickled squid.
decisions: Control tokens remain on their source rows and in their original sequence. Genuine sentence continuations retain row boundaries; other omitted subjects are restored from scene context. Unknown historical warrior gender stays neutral. Item names follow the shared glossary; established imported prose and provenance remain intact.
